t: Introduction and overview — Juan Carlos I Amphibious Assault Ship
name: Introduction and overview — Juan Carlos I Amphibious Assault Ship — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Juan Carlos I Amphibious Assault Ship
description: Introduction and overview of the Juan Carlos I Amphibious Assault Ship: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. Spain's Juan Carlos I — 27,079 tons with a ski-jump — is a strategic projection ship operating Harriers and helicopters plus landing craft and 900+ troops. The design was exported to Australia as the two Canberra-class LHDs, making it the basis for allied amphibious fleets. Baseline facts: Spanish strategic projection ship; 27,079 tons; ski-jump; basis for Australia's Canberras..
